featureIcons.title: no corn syrup
featureIcons.desc: Sweet is fine. Sugar-lab sweet is not. So we left the high fructose corn syrup on the bottom shelf where it belongs.

featureIcons.title: No seed oils
featureIcons.desc: We skip the ultra-processed seed oils and use ingredients that actually belong in food. If it reads like a chemistry project, it’s not in this bottle.

featureIcons.title: no additives
featureIcons.desc: No preservatives. No artificial nonsense. No “what is that?” ingredients hiding behind words you can’t pronounce.

featureIcons.title: Gluten Free
featureIcons.desc: No gluten. No thickening tricks. No drama. Just sauce that plays nice with your diet and acts up on the grill.
